entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4658260373306002944 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/ogle-lmc-ecl-09114-a/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Pietrzynski et al. (2019), Nature 567, 200, Table 1: distance modulus 18.490 +/- 0.028 for OGLE-LMC-ECL-09114, converted here as 10^(1 + m/5) pc (https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.08096): 49888 +/- 643 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0576 +/- 0.0529 mas (same row, RUWE 1.22), 1.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1.809, -0.256 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4658260373306002944 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204658260373306002944).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,236 K and log g 2.116 (u1 0.560, u2 0.193): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
